title: plugin-grid: server-grouped grid sends `select=id,[object Object],…` when the view's columns are objects — every group shows INVALID_FIELD (17.5.0 regression)
body:
Found while upgrading HotCRM from `@objectstack/*` 17.4.0 to 17.5.0 (objectstack-ai/hotcrm#1970) and checking the console in a browser.

## Symptom

A grid list view that declares `grouping` and writes its `columns` as objects (`{ field, width, … }`) renders its group headers with correct counts. Every expanded group then shows this instead of rows:

```
Unknown field '[object Object]' on object 'crm_product' (also: [object Object], …). 'select' chooses which fields to return; …
```

In HotCRM this breaks the default list of **Products**, **Knowledge Articles** and **Forecasts**. All three are `grouping` plus object `columns`.

## Wire evidence (17.5.0 console, `objectstack dev`)

```
200 GET /api/v1/data/crm_product?top=50&sort=name&select=id,product_code,name,category,family,sku,list_price,cost,is_active
400 GET /api/v1/data/crm_product?top=50&skip=0&sort=name+asc&select=id,[object+Object],[object+Object],…&filter=["and",["category","=","service"]]
    {"code":"INVALID_FIELD","field":"[object Object]","object":"crm_product", …}
```

The 400 repeats once per group.

**Control:** the same app, view and data on 17.4.0 makes only the flat request, with a correct `select`, and renders all 13 products.

## Mechanism (objectui `main` @ `88fbd793`)

- `packages/plugin-grid/src/ObjectGrid.tsx`, `getSelectFields()`. The `schemaColumns` branch maps each entry through `columnIdentity(c)`. The `schemaFields` branch (`return withHarvestedFields(ensureId((schemaFields as any[]).filter(passesProjectionGate)))`, around line 2424) returns the entries **unmapped**. When the view's fields are column objects, the objects themselves end up in `$select`.
- `packages/data-objectstack/src/index.ts` then serializes `$select` with `selectFields.join(',')`, which produces `[object Object]`.
- Before objectui#7189 / #10878 (server-side grid grouping), a grouped ObjectGrid under ListView got its rows as inline `data`, so this path never reached the wire. With server grouping, `setGroupRowQuery(groupQuery)` carries this `$select` into every per-group page request. The 17.5 server refuses unknown `select` keys instead of widening the projection, so the latent bug became a visible failure.

## Reproduce

```ts
defineView({ list: {
  type: 'grid',
  data: { provider: 'object', object: 'crm_product' },
  columns: [{ field: 'name' }, { field: 'category' }],
  grouping: { fields: [{ field: 'category', order: 'asc' }] },
} })
```

Open the list. Every group shows the INVALID_FIELD message. With `collapsed: true` the error appears only when a group is expanded.

## Suggested direction (not a ruling)

Map the `schemaFields` branch through `columnIdentity` the same way the `schemaColumns` branch does, so both branches project field names. It would also help to make the data adapter refuse a non-string `$select` entry rather than `join` it. Add a test with a server-grouped grid and object columns.

HotCRM will not work around this in app metadata. Its views are valid, and rewriting `columns` as strings would drop widths, pinning and summaries.
